div.head: VII Atr 1.1
div.ab: Et constituerunt inprimis Dei misericordiam et auxilium inuocare ieiuniis, elemosinis, confessione et abstinentia á malefactis et iniustitia.
Et constituerunt inprimis Dei misericordiam et auxilium invocare ieiuniis, elemosinis, confessione et abstinentia á malefactis et iniustitia.
Et constituerunt inprimis Dei misericordiam et auxilium invocare ieiuniis, elemosinis, confessione et abstinentia a malefactis et iniustitia.
Und sie verordneten zuerst, Gottes Erbarmen und Hilfe anzurufen durch Fasten, Almosen, Beichte und Enthaltung von Missethaten und Ungerechtigkeit.
And they ordained first to call upon God's mercy and help by fasting, almsgiving, confession and abstaining from misdeeds and injustice.
And they agreed first of all to invoke the mercy and help of God by fasts and almsgiving, by confession, and by abstaining from misdeeds and injustice.
And they first agreed to call upon God’s mercy and help by fasting, almsgiving, confession, and abstaining from sins and injustice.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
